senses.gloss:
चण् चण् [cf. rt. चन् and वण् and वन्],
cl. 1. P. चणति, &c., to sound, to give; to
go, to injure, hurt, kill: Caus. चणयति or चाण-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अचीचणत् and अचचाणत्.

चण चण, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a com-
pound) renowned, famous for, known [cf. विद्या-
चण and अक्षर-चण]; (अस्), m. = चणक, the
chick-pea.
—चण-द्रुम, अस्, m., N. of a plant,
= क्षुद्र-गोक्षुर; (also written चणी-द्रम.)
—चण-पत्त्री, f., N. of a plant; [cf. रुदन्ती.]

चणक, अस्, m. the chick-pea (Cicer Arietinum);
N. of a Muni, the father of Cāṇakya; (अका), f.
linseed, Linum Usitatissimum (अतसी), [cf. चण्डिका];
(इका), f. a kind of grass, = क्षेत्र-जा, गो-दग्धा,
सु-नीला, हिमा.
—चणकात्मज (˚क-आत्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a sage, also called Cāṇakya or Vatsyāyana.
[]
—चणकाम्लक (˚क-अम्ल), अम्, n. = चणक-
लवण, pease with salt, sour pease.
—चणकाम्ल-
वार्, र्, n. acid drops of water on the leaves of the
cicer.

चाणक, अस्, ई, अम् (an adj. formed fr. चाणक्य),
relating to Cāṇakya.

चण्ड् चण्ड्, cl. 1. and 10. A. चण्डते and
चण्डयते, -यितुम्, to be angry; to be
wrathful or passionate; [cf. Goth. hata; Eng. hate;
Germ. hasse; Lat. odi ?].

चण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, fierce, violent, impetuous, hot,
warm, ardent with passion, passionate, wrathful, angry,
cruel; active, quick; mischievous, evil; pungent,
acrid; circumcised; चण्डम्, ind. violently, passion-
ately, fiercely, in anger; (अस्), m. an evil being, a
demon, (चण्डस्य नप्त्यः, the daughters of
Caṇḍa, a class of female demons); an epithet of
Śiva; also of Skanda; N. of a Daitya; of an
attendant of Yama; or of Śiva; the tamarind tree;
(आ), f. a N. of the goddess Durgā, applied especially
to her incarnation for the purpose of destroying the
Asura or demon called Mahiṣa, (this exploit forms
the subject of a section of the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa,
and is particularly celebrated in Bengal at the Durgā-
pūjā, or festival held in honour of the goddess,
towards the close of the year, about Oct.-Nov.); N.
of one of the eight Nāyikās or Śaktis of Durgā; N.
of a goddess fulfilling the orders of the twelfth Arhat of
the present Ava-sarpiṇī; N. of a river; N. of several
prickly plants, = ओषधि, Andropogon Aciculatus;
Mucuna Pruritus (कपि-कच्छु); Salvinia Cucculata
(आखु-कर्णी), = श्वेत-दूर्वा and = लिङ्गिनी; a per-
fume, commonly Chor; (ई), f. a N. of Durgā; a
passionate woman, a vixen; a term of endearment
applied to a mistress; N. of the wife of Uddālaka;
N. of a metre consisting of four lines of thirteen
syllables each; (अम्), n. heat, warmth; passion,
wrath; [cf. अ-चण्डी, उच्-चण्ड, प्र-च्˚, चाण्ड.]
—चण्ड-कर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
—चण्ड-कोलाहला, f. a kind of musical instrument.
—चण्ड-कौशिक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kakṣī-
vat; (अम्), n. (?) title of a drama.
—चण्ड-गिरिक,
अस्, m., N. of a man.
—चण्ड-घण्टा, f., a N.
of Durgā.
—चण्ड-ता, f. and चण्ड-त्व, अम्, n.
warmth, pungency; warmth of temper, passionate-
ness.
—चण्ड-तुण्डक, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Garuḍa.
—चण्ड-दीधिति, इस्, m. ‘having hot rays,’
the sun; [cf. चण्डांशु.]
—चण्ड-नायिका, f. an
epithet of the goddess Durgā; N. of one of the
eight Nāyikās or Śaktis of Durgā.
—चण्ड-बल,
अस्, m., N. of one of the monkey followers of Rāma.
—चण्ड-भानु, उस्, m., N. of a man.
—चण्ड-
भार्गव, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman of the family
of Cyavana.
—चण्ड-महावीर-तन्त्र, अस्, m. title
of a Buddhist work, = कल्लवीर-तन्त्र.
—चण्ड-
महासेन, अस्, m., N. of a king of Ujjayinī.
—चण्ड-
मुण्डा, f. a form of Durgā; [cf. चर्म-मुण्ड
and चामुण्डा.]
—चण्ड-मृग, अस्, m. a wild
animal; epithet of a passionate man.
—चण्ड-रव,
अस्, m., N. of a jackal.
—चण्ड-रुद्रिका, f. know-
ledge of mystical nature, acquired by worship of the
Nāyikās.
—चण्ड-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, violent, warm,
passionate; (वती), f. an epithet of Durgā; N. of
one of the eight Nāyikās or Śaktis of Durgā.
—चण्ड-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince (probably
a corruption of चन्द्र-वर्मन्).
—चण्ड-विक्र-
म, अस्, आ, अम्, of impetuous valour; (अस्), m., N.
of a prince.
—चण्ड-वृष्टि-प्रयात, अम्, n., N.
of a metre of four lines of twenty-seven syllables
each.
—चण्ड-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, having an impetuous
course or current, violent; (अस्), m., N. of a Gandharva
chief.
—चण्ड-शक्ति, इस्, m., N. of a Daitya.
—चण्डांशु (˚ड-अं˚), उस्, m., the sun (‘having
hot rays;’ cf. चण्ड-दीधिति).
—चण्डादित्य-
तीर्थ (˚ड-आद्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—चण्डा-
शोक (˚ड-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a prince, also called
Kāmāśoka, and as a protector of Buddhism, Dharmā-
śoka.
—चण्डी-कुसुम, अस्, m. red oleander; [cf.
रक्त-करवीर.]
—चण्डी-दास, अस्, m., N. of the
author of a commentary called Kāvya-prakāśa-ṭīkā.
—चण्डी-देवी-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a scholiast.
—चण्डी-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. = चण्डिका-माहात्म्य.
[]
—चण्डीश (˚डी-ईश), अस्, m. the husband of Caṇḍī,
Śiva.
—चण्डेश्वर (˚डा-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘Caṇḍā's
lord,’ an epithet of Śiva; N. of a writer on juris-
prudence; also of an astronomer.
—चण्डोग्रा (˚ड-
उग्˚), f., N. of one of the eight Nāyikās, or Śaktis
of Durgā.
चाण्ड चाण्ड, अम्, n. (fr. चण्ड), violence.
चण्डि, इस्, f. = चण्डी, a N. of Durgā.

चण्डिका, f. a N. of Durgā; a N. of the Devī-
māhātmya; Linum Usitatissimum; [cf. उमा, देवी,
हैमवती, चणका.]
—चण्डिक-घण्ट, अस्, m.
(? fr. चण्डिका + घण्ट, q. v.), a N. of Śiva.
—चण्डिका-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. a section of the
Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa.
चण्डिन्, ई, m., N. of an author; [cf. चामुण्ड.]
चण्डिमन्, आ, m. passion, violence, cruelty; heat.

चण्डिल, अस्, m., N. of Rudra; a barber; a kind
of pot-herb [cf. वास्तूक]; (आ), f., N. of a river.

चण्डी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to enrage,
make angry or violent.

चण्डात चण्डात, अस्, m. fragrant oleander,
Nerium Odorum.

चण्डातक चण्डातक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr.
चण्ड ?), a short petticoat.

चण्डाल चण्डाल, अस्, m. (fr. चण्ड ?, cf.
चाण्डाल), an outcast, a Caṇḍāla, the generic name
for a man of the lowest and most despised of the
mixed tribes, born from a Śūdra father and Brāhman
mother.
—चण्डाल-कन्द, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous
plant.
—चण्डाल-ता, f. or चण्डाल-त्व, अम्, n. the
state or condition of a Caṇḍāla.
—चण्डाल-वल्लकी,
f. the lute of the Caṇḍāla, a common lute.

चाण्डाल चाण्डाल, अस्, m. = चण्डाल, a name
of an impure or degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah,
[]
an outcast; (ई), f. a woman of the same tribe; N. of
a plant, = लिङ्गिनी.

चण्डालिका, f. the lute of the Caṇḍāla, a common
or vulgar lute; an epithet of Durgā; a kind of plant.
—चण्डालिका-बन्ध, अस्, m. a kind of knot.

चाण्डालिका, f. a vulgar lute, the lute of the
Caṇḍāla; a N. of Durgā; a kind of herb; [cf.
चण्डालिका.]
—चाण्डालिकाश्रम (˚का-आश्˚), अस्, m.
N. of the hermitage of Cāṇḍālikā.

चण्डु चण्डु, उस्, m. a rat; a small monkey,
Simia Erythræa.

चाणकीन चाणकीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चणक),
fit for or sown with the chick-pea (a field &c.).

चाणक्य चाणक्य, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr.
चणक, N. of a Muni), N. of the sage Vātsyāyana;
N. of a celebrated Brāhman also called Viṣṇu-gupta,
the reputed author of a work on morals and the princi-
ples of government. He is said to have destroyed
the Nanda dynasty and to have made Candra-gupta
(q. v.) king, whose minister he became. From the
tone of his advice to princes he has been styled the
Machiavelli of India; (अम्), n., scil. शास्त्रम्, the
work of Cāṇakya, on morals and polity.
—चाणक्य-
मूलक, अम्, n. a kind of radish; [cf. कौटिल्य.]
—चाणक्य-श्लोक, आस्, m. pl. detached stanzas on
morals and the principles of government, supposed
to be written by the Brāhman Cāṇakya or compiled
by him.

चाणूर चाणूर, अस्, m., N. of a prince; also
of a wrestler in the service of Kaṃsa, slain by Kṛṣṇa,
and identified with the Daitya Varāha.
—चाणूर-
सूदन, अस्, m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
